Signs of the World

Recycling

History

The symbol was created for the first Earth Day in 1970 by Gary Anderson, then a 23-year-old University of Southern California student. His design won a contest run by the Container Corporation of America that drew more than 500 entries, and earned him a $2,500 scholarship.

Adoption

The three chasing arrows are recognized around the world. Countless variations exist, but they all preserve the base symbol design.
